fields.description: Issue includes editorials and local political coverage criticizing the Miami Crime Commission and discussing federal investigations of gambling; a detailed account and commentary on the Miami Herald warehouse fire and fire-safety practices; reporting on city commission election qualification issues including the anti-Communist oath; discussion of African American voter registration and municipal services, with references to access to public facilities and beaches; coverage of church opposition to racetrack gambling; a continuing piece on alleged press bribery tied to medical associations and opposition to a national health program; local court and police-blotter items; and business/civic reporting including Miami International Airport passenger and cargo statistics, alongside regular columns and advertisements.
